fast_lane.reference_curve: tenant's own median per-position hazard from its other scripts once it has 1,000+ connected calls; else the VP default prior [0.15, 0.08, 0.06, 0.05, 0.05, 0.04, 0.04, 0.04] (ASSUMED, l6)
fast_lane.alignment: hang-up time (carrier BYE, caller side) attributed to the moment whose clause audio was playing or ended within the last 2.0 s (I); hang-ups during the caller's own turn are attributed to the caller turn after the moment
fast_lane.moment_identity: brief slot + clause index + shape hash; a changed shape is a new moment with fresh counts

statistics.unit: contact; arm = hash(contact_id, experiment_id), sticky for the experiment
statistics.allocation: 50/50; safety ramp: first 50 variant calls at 20%, guardrails only, excluded from the confirmatory read (I)
preregistration: max duration 28 days, min 7 days so weekdays and novelty effects wash out (I; novelty variants were falsely declared in 82% of Thompson runs, l6 s.4.6)
analysis: two-proportion with contact-clustered standard errors
stop rule: fixed horizon; harm-only early stop by always-valid test on guardrails
statistics.power_formula: Fleiss two-proportion, alpha 0.05 two-sided, power 0.8, no continuity correction; reproduces l6 50->45 = 1565

power_table.test: line fix, local hazard at the line 10% -> 5% (l6 s.4.8 uses 435 reaching ~ 592 calls/arm)
objection: call continues 2+ turns past the objection 50% -> 60%

statistics.under_powered: if projected n by max duration < required: state 'under-powered: about N more calls (~D days at your volume)'; options: larger MDE only, exploratory (observed, not causal), simulate only, wait
statistics.concurrency: one confirmatory experiment per slot; at most 3 per agent on orthogonal slots; K>2 arms -> Bonferroni

aa.shadow: every eligible call carries a shadow label S1/S2 = hash(contact_id,'shadow',month); the production procedure runs on shadow labels for every metric that may be a primary
aa.permutation: 1,000 re-randomisations of contacts over the last 90 days
aa.gate: an experiment on metric X starts only when shadow A/A on X has the planned n per arm and the empirical false-winner rate is <= 6.5% (binomial noise band around 5% at 1,000 permutations) (C/I)

statistics.readout: effect and 95% interval from the pre-registered test; for bandits from a 10% uniform held-out split or AIPW, never from the bandit's own means

decision.promote: interval excludes 0 in the right direction and no guardrail breached -> A2 card
decision.discard: harm, or interval excludes the MDE
decision.inconclusive: keep control; lesson 'no detectable effect at n'

statistics.expiry: 60 days default, 90 max (l6 60-90); drift: promoted metric outside the test interval two weeks running -> 'stale'; expiry -> re-confirm card (10% holdback for the re-test horizon if powered, else label 'unconfirmed since <date>')

bandits.policy: discounted Thompson, gamma 0.97/day; 10% uniform exploration floor used for read-outs
eligibility: 1,000+ connected/day on one script for 14 days
outcome delay <= 7 days or a validated leading indicator
bandits.stop: exploration on 10-digit CLIs stops when monitor M08 fires (TRAI reg 21A)

statistics.segment_priors: v3 only: aggregate counts, 10+ opted-in tenants, ~3,000+ calls/day combined, small estimated tau, contract clause, never WhatsApp platform data
statistics.holdout: v3 opt-in: 5% of contacts on a client-chosen baseline version (predicate and catastrophic fixes still apply) for an honest 'since you started' number
